text:
natalie: FYI seeing a short-lived reconnect surge on /v2/stream in ap-south after today's backoff change. Console shows a spike in reconnect events but token billing is flat. anyone see correlation?

omar: which metric? ws.reconnect_events or ws.session_reconnects? they differ.

natalie: ws.reconnect_events on the live panel. query: `sum(rate(ws.reconnect_events[1m])) by (region)`

lee: backoff tweak was to reduce exponential from 500ms->200ms floor for faster recovery. could lead to quick retries creating multiple reconnect events before resume settles.

infra-bot: deploy: backoff-tuning v3 rolled to ap-south at 08:12 UTC. rollout_id=rl-2026-03-23-21.

omar: logs show same resume_token across the rapid reconnects. telemetry tags include `socket_id` so each handshake counted. billing dedupes by token, so billing stays flat.

natalie: ops alert fired. can we suppress paging while we validate?

lee: temp fix: change alert to use `billing.resume_successes` for paging OR increase threshold. I'll open a quick PR to increase threshold for 1 hour.

omar: longer fix: emit `reconnect_dedup_key` tag (hash(resume_token|ts_bucket)) and use that for metrics ingestion. keep emission behind a flag.

console: product asks for an "experimental deduped" panel instead of changing global panels to avoid confusing customers.

natalie: ok owners: lee -> alert threshold PR, omar -> dedup_key flag + metric patch, infra-bot -> note deploy id in incident doc, console -> create experimental panel. I'll mute the page for the canary group for 30m.

infra-bot: alert muted: ws_reconnect_surge (muted by natalie for 30m).

omar: small snippet for dedup key:
```
key = f"{resume_token}|{int(time.time()/20)}"
dedup = sha1(key).hexdigest()[:10]
metrics.count('ws.reconnect', 1, tags={'dedup_key': dedup, 'phase': phase})
```

natalie: thanks all, will watch the compare panel and unmute if things stabilize.
